summary: Amazon.com Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a public debt offering. It issued C$13.967 billion aggregate principal amount of notes across five tranches (2029-2056 maturities) under an S-3 shelf registration. The offering closed on June 12, 2026 at varying coupon rates (3.400% to 5.000%). Net proceeds were ~C$13.934 billion. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No change of control, restructuring, or shareholder return event is involved. The filing merely satisfies SEC reporting obligations for a completed shelf takedown.
